name: theory-sharpen
description: Systematically assess whether a paper's theoretical results can be strengthened: relax assumptions, sharpen rates, align theory with model and experiments, and benchmark against state-of-the-art literature. Use when user says "sharpen theory", "strengthen results", "relax assumptions", "improve rates", "理论提升", "放宽假设", "优化rate", "theory alignment", "理论对齐", or wants to go beyond proof correctness toward theoretical optimality and practical relevance.
